prompt: Who was the father of the Russian stage actress and singer "Baroness Olga Vadimovna von Root?"
answer: Baroness Olga Vadimovna von Root was the daughter of **Baron Vadim Nikolayevich (Nicholaievitch) von Root**, a Russian imperial military officer and nobleman who served in the White Army.
